name: Node.js
description: Runs the Claude Code CLI, npx-based installers and MCP connectors, and Playwright.
notes: Installed by Homebrew (or apt, shown as a command). Rollback is not supported for system packages; use nvm or fnm to switch Node versions.

name: Go
description: Builds the MCP server binaries that are installed with go install.
notes: Installed by Homebrew (or apt, shown as a command). Rollback is not supported for system packages.

name: Git
description: Creates task worktrees, commits and pull request branches.
notes: macOS ships git with the Xcode Command Line Tools; that copy counts as installed, but `brew upgrade git` / `brew uninstall git` only work on a Homebrew copy.

name: Claude Code CLI
description: Runs the agent of every pipeline stage.
notes: Managed versions live under the orchestrator home and are linked from its bin folder, which the daemon puts first on PATH; a global install elsewhere is reported as the system copy and left alone.

name: Playwright
description: Drives Chromium for UAT screenshots and end-to-end evidence.
notes: Recommended. After each install `playwright install chromium` downloads the browser into Playwright's shared cache (outside the orchestrator home); uninstall does not remove that cache.

name: ffmpeg
description: Transcodes recorded evidence to MP4.
notes: Recommended: without it evidence videos stay in their recorded format.

name: Docker
description: Runs the containers agents start for integration tests, and Docker-based MCP connectors.
notes: Optional. On macOS install Docker Desktop, OrbStack or Colima yourself; on Linux the apt command needs sudo, so it is shown rather than run.

name: BMAD Method
description: BMAD agents and workflows, installed as Claude Code skills (bmad-*).
notes: Installs into the home folder: _bmad/ plus the Claude skills BMAD lists in _bmad/_config/skill-manifest.csv (bmad-*, wds-*, …), all of which are snapshotted. Update uses --action quick-update, which keeps every installed module and its settings (verified 2026-10-18 with core, bmm and cis: 6.12.3 → 6.12.4). A fresh install adds the bmm module.

name: Get Shit Done (GSD)
description: GSD's spec-driven workflow for Claude Code: skills, agents and hooks under ~/.claude.
notes: GSD also edits ~/.claude/settings.json (hooks, statusline) and writes ~/.claude/package.json; those shared files are not snapshotted, so a rollback restores GSD's own files only. Uninstall runs GSD's own --uninstall first, which removes its settings entries. npm marks get-shit-done-cc@1.42.3 as deprecated (observed 2026-10-18).

name: Superpowers
description: Claude Code plugin with skills for planning, TDD, debugging and code review.
notes: Claude Code installs and updates plugins at their latest version only. Rollback restores a snapshot of the plugin's cache folder and its installed_plugins.json entry (best effort); restart Claude Code afterwards.

name: GitHub MCP server
description: Runs the GitHub connector for agents without Docker.
notes: Built with Go (the go package is installed first). v1.14.0 declares go >= 1.26.8, so an older Go downloads a newer toolchain when GOTOOLCHAIN allows it. A `go install` build prints no release number for --version, so the version shown is the one the orchestrator installed.

name: Grafana MCP server
description: Runs the Grafana connector for agents without Docker.
notes: Built with Go (the go package is installed first). v1.6.3 declares go >= 1.26.5, so an older Go downloads a newer toolchain when GOTOOLCHAIN allows it.

name: Gitleaks
description: Secret scanning for the Check Security Automatically stage.
notes: Required by the security stage. Installed by Homebrew. Rollback is not supported for system packages.

name: Trivy
description: Dependency, container image and IaC scanning, and SBOMs, for the security stage.
notes: Required by the security stage. Installed by Homebrew. Rollback is not supported for system packages.

name: Semgrep
description: Static analysis (SAST) for the security stage.
notes: Required by the security stage. Installed by Homebrew. Rollback is not supported for system packages.

name: OSV-Scanner
description: Lockfile vulnerability check for the security stage.
notes: Recommended. Installed by Homebrew. Rollback is not supported for system packages.

name: Syft
description: SBOM generation for the security stage.
notes: Recommended. Installed by Homebrew. Rollback is not supported for system packages.

name: Checkov
description: Terraform, Kubernetes and Helm misconfiguration scanning for the security stage.
notes: Recommended when the repositories hold infrastructure code. Installed by Homebrew. Rollback is not supported for system packages.

name: actionlint
description: Validates GitHub Actions workflows written by the Make Releases Automatic stage.
notes: Recommended for repositories on GitHub Actions. Installed by Homebrew. Rollback is not supported for system packages.

name: Hadolint
description: Dockerfile linting for the Make Releases Automatic stage.
notes: Recommended. Installed by Homebrew. Rollback is not supported for system packages.

name: promtool (Prometheus)
description: Validates the alert rules written by the Watch the System & Send Alerts stage.
notes: Recommended. Installs Prometheus, which ships promtool. Installed by Homebrew. Rollback is not supported for system packages.

name: k6
description: Load tests for the Test Heavy Traffic & Prepare for Problems stage.
notes: Required by the load stage. Installed by Homebrew. Rollback is not supported for system packages.

name: Spectral
description: Lints the OpenAPI contract in the Set Up the API for Customers stage.
notes: Required by the customer API stage. Versioned install: pick, update or roll back a version here.

name: govulncheck
description: Reachable Go vulnerabilities for the security stage.
notes: Recommended for Go repositories. Built with Go (the go package is installed first); versioned install with rollback. Its -version contacts the vulnerability database, so the check runs -h and the version shown is the one the orchestrator installed.
